messages:
elena: Heads-up — interviewer prep packs created from ATS export 2026-03-16-047 are missing the rubric link and the candidate 'experience_level' column. Noticed on 3 hires. Anyone else seeing this?

samir: yep saw one earlier today, same export id. looks like header drift after the ATS field rename last week.

maya: which pipeline produced that export — nightly ETL or the manual ad-hoc export?

elena: nightly ETL (scheduled job + manual on-demand both affected). here's the head of the csv we pulled:
```
applicant_id,name,email,position,stage,location,experience_level,cv_url,rubric_url
```

samir: ah the ATS actually renamed candidate.experience_level -> experience_level_v2 in the schema. ETL mapping hasn't been updated so columns shift and rubric_url gets moved or dropped.

jordan: temporary workaround: run the header-fix transform to rename experience_level_v2 -> experience_level before running prep-pack generator. CLI: `python scripts/fix_headers.py --file export.csv --map experience_level_v2:experience_level`

maya: heads-up that some downstream consumers expect the old header name. If we rename on export we'll need a compatibility layer so we don't break dashboards.

samir: I'll open a tiny PR in repo infra/ats-adapters to accept both headers (experience_level OR experience_level_v2) and add a unit test.

elena: can you also add a check in the prep-pack generator that asserts rubric_url exists and errors early if missing? we had an interview where interviewer didn't get the rubric and it hurt scoring consistency. :disappointed:

ats-bot: ats-bot: Export job 2026-03-16-047 completed with warnings: unmapped_field=experience_level_v2, missing_expected_field=rubric_url.

jordan: I can rerun transform+generator for the 3 affected exports today if ops gives thumbs-up.

maya: +1 from me. I'll coordinate with hiring team to let them know packs are being regenerated.

samir: PR opened: infra/ats-adapters#412 — parser accepts both headers and preserves ordering. Will add migration note.

elena: great. after PR lands, can someone run a backfill for exports from 2026-03-10..2026-03-17? put results in #hiring-ops.

jordan: scheduling rerun now. job id: rerun-2169998888-1, ETA ~30m. I'll post status. :eyes:

ats-bot: ats-bot: Rerun scheduled (rerun-2169998888-1). Expect ~3 exports regenerated.

elena: thanks everyone — also let's update the interviewer training checklist to include "verify rubric present in prep pack" so interviewers can flag missing docs during warmup.

samir: noted, adding checklist item + a small unit test for the prep-pack generator.

maya: ping me when rerun completes, I'll notify the interview panel.

elena: tagging @samir @jordan — please add a short runbook snippet in Confluence under Hiring Ops -> ATS Exports so on-call knows how to handle header drift next time.

jordan: will do.

elena: thanks all.
